metadata.title: DNS Resolution and Recursion

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring deterministic, controlled, and trusted DNS resolution behavior through governed recursion and upstream dependency management.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Recursive DNS resolvers, resolution paths, upstream dependencies, and validation behavior.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines how DNS name resolution and recursion are constrained to preserve correctness, integrity, and predictable trust behavior.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for guidance that DNSSEC provides no security benefit unless resolvers perform validation, and for authoritative discussion of validating resolver behavior, as described in Section 3.4 and Sections 5.1–5.2.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to Withstand objectives, emphasizing enforcement of trust decisions close to the point of use to limit adversary success, as described in Section 3.2.

metadata.remarks: DNS Resolution and Recursion defines how DNS queries are resolved through controlled recursion paths and governed upstream dependencies. This pattern ensures that name resolution results are correct, validated, and not silently influenced by untrusted intermediaries.

components.title: Controlled DNS Recursion
components.description: Defines how recursive DNS queries are constrained to approved resolution paths and upstream services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of DNS recursion paths to influence or redirect resolution results.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit governance of upstream DNS recursion dependencies to limit untrusted influence.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS recursion is constrained to approved upstream services to prevent unauthorized influence.

components.title: DNS Validation at Resolution
components.description: Ensures DNS responses are validated during resolution rather than trusted implicitly.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Adversary-in-the-middle attacks attempting to inject or modify DNS responses.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: DNSSEC and related validation mechanisms to verify authenticity and integrity of DNS responses.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS data integrity is verified during resolution to prevent acceptance of tampered responses.

components.title: Resolver Fail-Closed Behavior
components.description: Defines resolver behavior when validation fails, upstream services are unavailable, or responses are inconsistent.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Inducing resolver failures to trigger fallback or fail-open behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Resolver behavior is defined to fail securely rather than accepting unverifiable data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS resolution behavior under failure conditions is explicitly defined to preserve trust.
